{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Define sentinel value
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Create a cleaned dataset excluding rows with sentinel baseline values
cleaned_df = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != sentinel_value]

# Calculate the change in biomarker (final - baseline)
cleaned_df['biomarker_change'] = cleaned_df['biomarker_final'] - cleaned_df['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute average change by arm
treatment_mean_change = cleaned_df[cleaned_df['arm'] == 'treatment']['biomarker_change'].mean()
control_mean_change = cleaned_df[cleaned_df['arm'] == 'control']['biomarker_change'].mean()

# Compute the difference in means
difference_in_means = treatment_mean_change - control_mean_change

# Print results
print(f"Treatment group mean biomarker change: {treatment_mean_change:.2f}")
print(f"Control group mean biomarker change: {control_mean_change:.2f}")
print(f"Difference in means: {difference_in_means:.2f}")"}
